title: SendGrid dynamic template placeholders render blank when the code uses substitutions
symptoms: {{first_name}} renders empty in the delivered email
Legacy template code moved to a d- template stops filling values
cause: Dynamic templates read only dynamic_template_data, and substitutions are documented as not to be combined with them. Code written for legacy templates still sends substitutions.
fix: Move every value into dynamic_template_data on each personalization and use Handlebars syntax in the template.
apply: personalizations: [{ to: [{ email }], dynamic_template_data: { first_name: 'Ana' } }], template_id: 'd-xxxxxxxx'
affected: SendGrid v3 Mail Send, dynamic templates (d- ids), as of 2026-10
